context.stage: Stage F1 - Application Shell and Authentication

task.description: Implement Stage F1 requirements SH-01 through SH-04 per the design artefact at src/design/shell-f1.md. Branch: feature/WF02-shf1a-20260528. Changes required: (1) web/src/api/client.ts - replace localStorage with in-memory module variable, remove refresh token logic; (2) web/src/types/api.ts - add JwtPayload, UserSession types; (3) web/src/auth/tokenUtils.ts - new file with decodeTokenPayload, resolveDisplayName; (4) web/src/auth/AuthContext.tsx - update AuthContextValue interface; (5) web/src/auth/AuthProvider.tsx - rewrite login(token) flow with health check + JWT decode; (6) web/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx - replace email/password with token input field; (7) web/src/components/layout/AppShell.tsx - role-aware nav with full 4-role matrix + user indicator. After implementation: run npm run type-check, npm run lint, npm run build (all must exit 0). Commit and push to feature branch.
acceptance_criteria: web/src/auth/tokenUtils.ts exists with decodeTokenPayload and resolveDisplayName
LoginPage has data-testid=login-token-input (password type) not email/password fields
